Use case: stylized-concept
Original Agora cozy pixel-art inventory sprite atlas, true transparent background, beautiful deliberate logical 32-48px icon clusters enlarged nearest neighbor. Match approved crop reference style, warm upper-left highlights, cool teal shadows, selective dark olive and brown outlines. Crisp hard pixels, no blur, no white sticker border, no text or letters, no grid, no ground or shadows. EXACT 6 columns x 4 rows, 24 isolated icons in equal cells with generous 20% gutters. All icons consistent size and quality, centered, no cell overlap.
Each icon is a CLOSED upright honey-kraft paper seed packet with folded crimped top, small cream label, botanical picture of the species on front, and a thin muted color band coordinated to its produce. ALL packets same rectangular silhouette and design. Picture must be large and readable, no written name or price. Detailed paper fold/shading. EXACT row-major order left-to-right then down:
1. Dawn radish: red radish with leafy top
2. Clover bulb: creamy lilac round bulb with clover leaves
3. Meadow kale: dark blue-green ruffled kale leaves
4. Honey pea: golden green pea pods
5. Pearl onion: ivory onion with upright green shoots
6. Ember pepper: red slender peppers
7. River melon: green striped round melon
8. Gold maize: golden corn ear in husk
9. Sun tomato: warm red tomato
10. Silk squash: pale buttery oblong squash
11. Amber pumpkin: ribbed amber pumpkin
12. Mist grape: dusty purple grape bunch
13. Rust yam: rusty purple sweet potato tuber
14. Plum bean: dark purple bean pods
15. Reed rice: golden arching rice grain stalks
16. Frost cabbage: pale blue-green cabbage head
17. Snow lettuce: pale ruffled lettuce head
18. Ice berry: frosted blue berry cluster
19. Sunflower: golden flower brown center
20. Rose: coral pink layered rose
21. Lavender: purple flower spikes
22. Tulip: coral cream cup-shaped tulip
23. Poppy: orange-red flower black center
24. Bluebell: arching violet-blue bell flowers
